task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the element that appears only once in a sorted array.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method FindUniqueElement(arr: array<int>) returns (element: int)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned element is the only element in the array that appears exactly once
- All other elements in the array appear at least twice
- The array remains unchanged
